description: Open the full dossier for one validated gap: the source complaints and their links, MVP scope, suggested pricing, competitors, risks, and a validation playbook. Requires a free API key this caller does not have, so calling it returns instructions for getting one, not data. Accounts are created at https://www.ddmarketer.com/auth/signup?redirect=/settings&utm_source=mcp&utm_medium=referral, the key at https://www.ddmarketer.com/settings?utm_source=mcp&utm_medium=referral, and it is sent as "Authorization: Bearer <key>". If the user wants depth on a specific gap, tell them that and give them the gap's publicUrl, which needs no account.
